svg.title: Showers client website CI/CD pipeline
svg.desc: The embedding guide provides a complete text walkthrough of this flow.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GitHub OIDC → AWS role
Trust + operation permissions

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. Hashed assets: immutable, one year
2. Images / fonts / uploads: 30 days

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. HTML + metadata: revalidate
4. Delete removed HTML only
Preserve assets and preview tree

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Request CloudFront invalidation
No completion wait

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HTTP HEAD of selected root
Up to six attempts; no body assertion

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Workflow result for this SHA + branch
Portal reconciles publication status

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deploy workflow
Push: main / preview; or manual dispatch

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check out run revision
Set up Node 22

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Verify Action pins → npm ci
Run unit tests

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PREVIEW=0
S3 root; invalidate /*
Smoke: public root

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PREVIEW=1
S3 _preview/; invalidate /_preview/*
Smoke: preview root

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Astro build → dist/
Import content.json; apply base path
